USE ONLY IF — You are working with body-state misreading, can stay oriented to the present, can think clearly enough to choose, and can stop at any time.
STOP NOW IF — Symptoms intensify, you feel faint, a medical problem may be possible, or repeated internal checking is escalating instead of settling.
DO INSTEAD — Keep attention external, stop symptom-testing or repeated body checking, and seek medical advice for new, severe, changing, or uncertain physical symptoms.
URGENT OVERRIDE — If you may harm yourself or someone else, are in immediate danger, cannot stay safe, or may have a medical emergency, stop and contact local emergency services now. Australia: call 000. For 24/7 crisis support in Australia, call Lifeline 13 11 14 or text 0477 13 11 14. Outside Australia, use your local emergency or crisis service.
This is self-help guidance, not diagnosis, treatment, or emergency care.
